title: Bottle for Enovid 10 mg Oral Contraceptive
lineage: Notes paraphrase selected source passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The institute describes Enovid, made by G. D. Searle & Co., as introduced for purchase for contraception in the United States in June 1960. The surviving bottle itself is dated after 1960; availability was limited by social, medical, and legal barriers.
